CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vibebloom_vpn_nodes (
  region_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY,
  region_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  aws_region VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  instance_type VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 't3.micro (Free Tier)',
  ebs_gb INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
  status VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'STOPPED',
  public_ip VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Auto-Assigned on Boot',
  wg_port INTEGER DEFAULT 51820,
  scraper_port INTEGER DEFAULT 8085,
  hours_used_month NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,
  last_started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  auto_stop_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  browser_profile VARCHAR(64),
  target_timezone VARCHAR(64),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(v ORDER BY CASE v.region_code WHEN 'US' THEN 1 WHEN 'UK' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_vpn_nodes v) AS vpn_nodes,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]'::json) FROM (SELECT * FROM vibebloom_scraped_trends ORDER BY scraped_at DESC, demand_score DESC LIMIT 24) t) AS trends,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m ORDER BY m.region_code), '[]'::json) FROM vibebloom_mobile_telemetry m) AS telemetry;

const dbRow = $input.first()?.json || {}; const vpnNodes = Array.isArray(dbRow.vpn_nodes) ? dbRow.vpn_nodes : []; const trends = Array.isArray(dbRow.trends) ? dbRow.trends : []; const telemetry = Array.isArray(dbRow.telemetry) ? dbRow.telemetry : []; const initialDataJson = JSON.stringify({ vpnNodes, trends, telemetry }); const html = ` VibeBloom — Multi-Region VPN, Etsy/Amazon Trend Scraper & Mobile Ad Monitor
VB

VibeBloom Growth & Multi-Region VPN Command Center

Mumbai KVM2 Brain + US/UK/AU Exit Nodes

1-Operator Desktop Scraper (Etsy/Amazon/TikTok) • Gemini + Ollama Niche Pipeline • Safe Real-Time Phone Monitor

Live n8n Paced Scraper (Modeled on Workflow 4 + Workflow 1)

Pulls real-time buyer autocomplete & bestseller signals from US (USD), UK (GBP), and Australia (AUD), then runs Gemini 2.5 Flash + Local Ollama (llama3.2:3b) to create copyright-safe slogans & UTM links.

AWS 12-Month Free Tier Guardrail (750 Hrs/Mo + 30GB EBS Total)

Combined Free-Tier Hours Used
19.8 / 750.0 hrs

🚀 1-Command AWS EC2 User-Data Bootstrap Script (Paste When Launching US, UK, or AUS t3.micro)

Automatically installs Docker + WeeJeWel/wg-easy (WireGuard VPN Web UI) + Regional Scraper Proxy on Ubuntu 24.04 (10GB EBS).

#!/bin/bash
apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 curl
systemctl enable --now docker
PUBLIC_IP=$(curl -s http://checkip.amazonaws.com)

# 1. Start Open-Source wg-easy (WireGuard VPN + Web Admin UI on Port 51821)
docker run -d --name=wg-easy \
  -e LANG=en \
  -e WG_HOST=$PUBLIC_IP \
  -e PASSWORD_HASH='$2b$12$coPqCsPtcFO.Ab99xylBNOW4.Iu7OOA2/ZIboHN6/1xca3MWo7fW6' \
  -e PORT=51821 -e WG_PORT=51820 \
  -e WG_DEFAULT_DNS=1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8 \
  -v ~/.wg-easy:/etc/wireguard \
  -p 51820:51820/udp -p 51821:51821/tcp \
  --cap-add=NET_ADMIN --cap-add=SYS_MODULE \
  --sysctl="net.ipv4.conf.all.src_valid_mark=1" \
  --sysctl="net.ipv4.ip_forward=1" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/wg-easy/wg-easy
Safe for Indian Smartphone (No TikTok App / Zero Indian SIM Leak)

📱 Real-Time Mobile Content, Ad ROAS & VibeBloom Order Monitor

Bookmark this URL on the operator's phone in India. It pulls live metrics via Mumbai n8n so nobody ever logs into the TikTok mobile app with an Indian SIM card.

Step-by-Step Organic TikTok Account Creation

Where & How to Create the Organic @VibeBloom.US Account

⚠️ CRITICAL: Do NOT click the TikTok signup link in your regular Indian browser! Indian ISPs block it, and if you sign up on an Indian IP, TikTok permanently tags the account as Region: IN (banned).

  1. Open your isolated US Browser Profile (Camoufox or Dolphin{anty}) with your US IP / VPN active.
  2. First, verify your browser shows 100% United States (IP + Timezone) at: https://whoer.net
  3. Inside that US browser, open the official TikTok Email Signup URL:
    https://www.tiktok.com/signup/phone-or-email/email
  4. Sign up using Email (e.g., user@example.com or user@example.com) — do NOT enter an Indian +91 phone number!
  5. Once logged in, go to Settings → Switch to Business Account → Apparel & Accessories.
  6. 3-Day Warm-Up (While Payoneer Verifies): Spend 10–15 mins/day scrolling & liking US floral/fashion TikToks before uploading your first video so TikTok scores the account as a genuine US human creator.
Using user@example.com for AWS Free Tier

How to Sign Up for AWS Free Tier with user@example.com

AWS Root Account signup does not use a "Sign in with Google OAuth" button, AND requires an interactive Indian RBI ₹2 card OTP + SMS OTP on your phone. Here is the fastest 3-minute way using your Gmail:

  1. Open the official AWS Free Tier registration page in your regular Indian browser:
    https://portal.aws.amazon.com/billing/signup
  2. Root User Email Address: Enter user@example.com (or user@example.com if your main address already has an old AWS account—both deliver straight to your user@example.com inbox!).
  3. AWS Account Name: VibeBloom-POD-Cloud
  4. Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to user@example.com.
  5. Select Personal — for your own projects, enter your Indian billing address, and complete the ₹2 refundable card check + phone OTP.
  6. Choose Basic Support — Free.
